$comment: PROPOSED English copy for what this design adds. Live text only: none of it is drawn into an illustration. Frontend owns interface wording and the game owner owns rule statements; every line that states a rule cites the rule source it paraphrases. Nothing here is approved.

Officer.name: Officer
Officer.summary: You start with one ordinary shot. You may register it during your own turn, from Round 1.
Officer.limit: One ordinary shot for the whole match.
Officer.mustNotSay: Nothing about identifying or guessing another player's faction or role: that step is archived (rules/overlays/direct-shot-decision.json). “Ordinary” is there because the final showdown gives every participant a special shot of its own (rules/overlays/final-showdown-decision.json): the card must not read as if the Officer had none left for it.

resourcePip.note: Accessible names for the pip. Each repeats what the card's status word already says; none is an outcome. “Shot used” is drawn by no state in protocol 1, which has no field for it (DSN-D02).

privateHandle.note: The handle's visible word never changes with role, turn or availability. Frontend's Show/Hide button labels stay as they are.

table.boardSyntheticLabel: Synthetic layout state. Not a match.

syntheticStudies.note: mothership:dev-only. Lettering for the two synthetic studies only, read by studies.html. No approved fact exists for either word; neither may appear in a connected match.
